name: fix-backend-ci-install
title: Restore CI dependency installation after staff PR merge
description: Align the backend dependency manifest with its existing lockfile so frontend and backend CI jobs can reach their test steps.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Both CI jobs stopped at backend npm ci before lint or tests because package.json declared mongoose-lean-virtuals ^0.8.0 while package-lock.json records ^2.0.0. PR #1274 keeps the existing lockfile and aligns the stale manifest entry. CI is the runnable verification for npm ci and subsequent tests.
